text:
elaine: Quick one — audit team asked for the final owner for the SRE KMS policy exceptions list (we have ~7 entries). Need someone to own reviewers + evidence packaging by EOD Mon. Who can take?
kevin: I can own the infra side. I'll validate the terraform state and confirm which keys are soft-exempt vs permanent.
kevin: fyi there's an open PR that touches key rotation code: PR #4128 — needs a quick review before I can mark permanence.
elaine: thanks kevin. can you also produce a short rationale per exception (1-2 lines) so compliance can accept?
nisha: I can help with the rationale language and confirm mapping to control SC-KMS-2 and CC7. If kevin tags the keys, I’ll draft the wording.
sam: pinging for a CR review — I can look at #4128 tonight. ETA ~3 hours. @kevin please leave comments where you want acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
kevin: cool. also note one key is in a partner HSM cluster (hsm-east-1) — we need the attestation artifact from the partner. nisha, is that okay to be listed as 3rd-party attestation?
nisha: yes, list it as "external HSM attestation" and attach the signed PDF. I'll add a note in the control mapping.
elaine: small ops ask — when you produce evidence, put everything under s3://redwood-compliance/audit-evidence/soc2/2026/kms-exceptions/ and include a manifest.txt with filenames + short desc. Example manifest line: `key-1234.pdf — partner attestation for hsm-east-1`
kevin: will do. sample command I'll use to stage the artifacts:
```
mkdir -p /tmp/kms-evidence && cp artifacts/*.pdf /tmp/kms-evidence
tar -czf kms-evidence-2765432100.tar.gz -C /tmp kms-evidence
aws s3 cp kms-evidence-2765432100.tar.gz s3://redwood-compliance/audit-evidence/soc2/2026/kms-exceptions/
```
elaine: perfect. also add a short notes.md with who approved the exception and the review date.
sam: quick question — do we need a JIRA ticket per exception or one ticket that bundles all 7?
nisha: compliance prefers one parent ticket per milestone + subtasks per exception. please create INFR-289-subtasks under INFR-289 (or update if it already exists).
kevin: created INFR-289-7exceptions and added links to PR #4128 + s3 manifest. I’ll update status to "evidence ready" once tar is uploaded.
devops-bot: CI pipeline for PR #4128 passed: all checks green (unit, infra-lint, key-rotation-smoke). :white_check_mark:
elaine: awesome — plan: kevin uploads evidence by EOD Mon, nisha finalizes language, sam reviews PR tonight. I’ll compile the audit bundle Tue morning and send to auditors. Thanks all. :rocket:
